title: CMDDR Genre
description: A document / speech TYPE in the Genre Registry (Table 1). Carries the genre's default register and its ceiling (maximum authority the issuer can exercise through it). Never fixes the authority of a particular passage.

defaultRegister.description: Presumptive register of the genre absent any special act.

ceiling.description: Maximum register the issuer can exercise through this genre. No Assessment may exceed it.

presumptiveWeight.description: Optional ordinal for ranking genres of equal issuer/ceiling by title (e.g. Dogmatic Constitution > Constitution > Decree > Declaration).

allOf.description: defaultRegister may not exceed ceiling (authentic-ordinary < ordinary-universal < extraordinary)
